name: Scroll Thread Check
purpose: Decide which structural rule of a mage's sealed scroll, if any, one hash breaks, from the facts the host read about that hash's threads. Send place, kind, outside, walk, rows, provenance or fact, separated by spaces; it answers ok, rootkind, dangling, unreachable, rowsmismatch, rowmissing, noprovenance, factnoledger, factunderived or gapunderived, and invalid request for anything else.
inputLabel: Request: place kind outside walk rows provenance fact
placeholder: first root none reached none unlisted none

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: ST-01: the app never answers ok when provenance is broken. ST-02: the app never answers ok when walk is reached and outside is some. ST-03: the app never answers ok when walk is lost. ST-04: the app never answers ok when fact is underived. ST-05: the app never answers ok when place is first and kind is not root.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  place is first and kind is not root → rootkind
  walk is reached and outside is some → dangling
  walk is lost → unreachable
  rows is mismatch → rowsmismatch
  rows is missing → rowmissing
  provenance is broken → noprovenance
  fact is noledger → factnoledger
  fact is underived → factunderived
  fact is gapunderived → gapunderived
  otherwise → ok
proposition.plain: Decide which structural rule of a mage's sealed scroll, if any, one hash breaks, from the facts the host read about that hash's threads.
